$comment: Contract for data/tables/material_links.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Material links
description: Records a material cites, one per row, in citation order. printing cites print profiles or evidence records (the first profile supplies the material's nozzle, bed and chamber guidance); h2c-status cites sources for its H2C status; use, durability and safety cite evidence records, which may be family context from another material. Environmental evidence is not listed: it is always the material's own environmental records.

fields.name: RecordID
fields.description: The cited profile (P), evidence record (Q) or source. The build checks the kind matches the link.
